title: Upgrade all installed packages with zypper
summary: Update all installed software to the newest available versions.

steps.explain: Upgrade installed packages to the newest available versions. You can use the full command 'update' or the short form 'up'.

alternatives.explain: Use the short form 'up' instead of 'update'.

rollback.explain: Downgrading packages is complex and not directly supported by a single command. It is recommended to back up your system before upgrading.

warnings: It is good practice to refresh the package list (zypper refresh) before upgrading.
